company.title: Remove Company from Navigation
company.confirmation: Are you sure you want to remove company "{companyName}" from navigation?

project.willNotDelete: Will NOT delete the project from the database
project.canLinkLater: You can link it again later
project.errorMessage: Failed to unlink project. Please try again.

building.title: Unlink Building from Project

building.willNotDelete: Will NOT delete the building from the database
building.canLinkLater: You can link it again later
building.errorMessage: Failed to unlink building. Please try again.

property.title: Unlink Property from Building

property.willUnlink: Unlink the property from the building
property.willNotDelete: Will NOT delete the property from the database
property.canLinkLater: You can link it again later
property.errorMessage: Failed to unlink property. Please try again.
